title: CDO Expression into OnePot PURE
author: Dana Mozaffari
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7v3hn8n

steps.title: Label PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Label three PCR tubes according to the intended reactions.

steps.title: Add catechol, CDO, and water
steps.instruction: Add catechol, CDO enzyme, and water to each tube in the volumes specified by the materials chart.

steps.title: Centrifuge briefly
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes briefly in a centrifuge so that all liquid collects at the bottom.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes for one hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add energy mix, proteins, ribosomes
steps.instruction: To each tube, add the Energy solution, the required proteins, and ribosomes.
